rows.label: tlk70000001_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Your eyes are sparkling, mo! I can
feel you're starting to see yourselves
as heroes, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_04_msg0002
rows.name:
A lot of people in the shopping
district have been helped by you, mo.
As chairman, I'm very grateful, mo.

rows.label: tlk70000001_04_msg0003
rows.name:
So... I want to do even more to help
you, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000001_04_msg0004
rows.name:
I'm not talking about money or
business, mo. I mean genuinely
repaying the favor, mo!

rows.label: tlk70000001_04_msg0005
rows.name:
When you're in trouble, I'll
definitely help, mo. I want you to
remember that, mo!
